premises.text: Pregnancy complications are on the rise and cost the healthcare system billions annually
premises.evidence_span: pregnancy complications have been on the rise. Diseases such as gestational diabetes, preeclampsia, and preterm birth are global epidemics that not only cost our healthcare system billions of dollars annually

premises.text: Prenatal checkups are inconvenient and limited by outdated technology
premises.evidence_span: these trips are inconvenient, expensive, and ultimately limited by 50-year-old antiquated technology

premises.text: Wearable devices combined with data analytics can improve prenatal care
premises.evidence_span: we're designing the future of prenatal care, with technology designed to improve the health of moms and babies

premises.text: The Bloom Life sensor can measure biopotentials in motion to provide health information
premises.evidence_span: the mom's heart's a muscle, the uterus is a muscle, and the baby's heart's a muscle, and each create a unique electrical signal which we can non-invasively measure through the sensor

premises.text: Bloom Life provides real-time information about uterine activity to expecting moms
premises.evidence_span: with Bloom Life, she's able to get a validated second opinion on what she's feeling to figure out what those weird pregnant sensations are

premises.text: The product can track unique pregnancy-specific health parameters
premises.evidence_span: this includes pregnancy-specific information no other wearable can track today, such as fetal movement and fetal heart rate

premises.text: Bloom Life aims to become standard of care and fully reimbursed by insurance
premises.evidence_span: our goal is for Bloom Life to become standard of care, fully reimbursed, and utilized by doctors all over to better track and manage the health of their moms

premises.text: Crowdsourcing data from moms can create a comprehensive dataset on maternal and fetal health
premises.evidence_span: we have an opportunity to crowdsource the largest and most comprehensive data set on maternal and fetal health ever collected

value.text: Bloom Life improves prenatal care and health outcomes for moms and babies
value.evidence_span: technology designed to improve the health of moms and babies

notes: Clinical studies and beta user feedback are excluded as traction.
